events.name: CeCe Winans - COME WORSHIP! Tour
events.info: The "COME WORSHIP! Tour" is an invitation from CeCe Winans to bring together audiences of every generation, ethnicity, and denomination while worshipping Jesus as a unified congregation. Winans is excited to bring along some of the biggest worship leaders for an evening designed to be unlike anything audiences have experienced before. Joined by special guest Charity Gayle, whose anthems including "Thank You Jesus for the Blood" and "I Speak Jesus" have become modern worship staples, the tour creates a sacred space marked by faith, expectancy, and unity. Rounding out the night will be Red Worship and Terrian, two of the newest and most powerful voices in worship music.

ticketLimit.info: There is an 8 tickets limit for this event.

events.name: Pensacola Ice Flyers vs. Huntsville Havoc
events.info: Pensacola Ice Flyers is a professional ice hockey team of the Southern Professional Hockey League and are the 2013, 2014, 2016 & 2021 SPHL Presidents Cup Champions! With many home games starting in October, the hockey experience is an EVENT, not just a game! Join some of the best fans in SPHL as the Pensacola Ice Flyers hit the ice and make a run for the Presidents Cup! You don't want to miss out on the exciting mid-game activities, giveaways, family fun, and great hockey at one of our 30 regular-season games at the Pensacola Bay Center starting in October and going all the way through April.
events.pleaseNote: Ticket prices go up $2 on day of game.

boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Box Office accepts Cash, MC, Visa, Honor ATM Cards, and local Checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: The Will Call window is located at the front Box Office window. Tickets held at Will Call can be picked up early as 1 1/2 hours prior to show. Customer must present the actual credit card, photo I.D., and the confirmation number.

generalInfo.generalRule: 1.) No smoking is permitted in theatre. 2.) No outside food or beverages are permitted in the theatre.
generalInfo.childRule: There are no age restrictions. Children under 2 are admitted free without seat. Child age for discounts is 2-12.
